newsitem.title: GERMANY: United doubles US-Frankfurt flights in June.
newsitem.headline: United doubles US-Frankfurt flights in June.

text.p: United Airlines said it will double its flights from the US to Frankfurt to four a day from June 17.
The daily Chicago and Washington to Frankfurt services will be increased with one extra flight on each route, a company statement said.
United will then fly five times a day between Germany and the US, including its daily Chicago-Duesseldorf service.
The routes are mostly operated with Boeing 777 aircraft with a Boeing 767-300 used for the second Washington route.
United and alliance partner Deutsche Lufthansa AG offer the largest capacity from Germany across the Atlantic, the statement noted.
The expansion follows the decision of other US carriers to reduce their services to Frankfurt, it added. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
